from d2_shipping import shipping_zone, shipping_cost, is_oversize

def test_zone():
    assert shipping_zone("DE") == 1
    assert shipping_zone("FR") == 2 and shipping_zone("NL") == 2
    assert shipping_zone("ZZ") == 3

def test_cost():
    assert shipping_cost(2, 1) == round(6.0 + 2.0 * 2, 2)
    assert shipping_cost(0.5, 3) == round(30.0 + 2.0 * 0.5, 2)

def test_oversize():
    assert is_oversize(101, 1, 1) is True
    assert is_oversize(100, 100, 50) is False
    assert is_oversize(100, 100, 51) is True
